import pandas as pd,numpy as np,statsmodels.formula.api as smf
w=pd.read_parquet('works.parquet')
w=w[w.year.notna()].copy()
w['y']=w['count__domains__DISTANCE_TRAVEL']/w.n_passages
w['late']=(w.year>=1876).astype(int)
ap=w.author_key.map(w.author_key.value_counts());w['prod']=np.log(ap)
print(len(w), w.y.mean())
def est(d):
    g=d.groupby(['genre','late']).y.mean().unstack()
    g=g.dropna();return (g[1]-g[0]).mean()
def boot(d,B=1000):
    r=np.random.default_rng(0);v=[]
    for _ in range(B):
        s=d.groupby(['genre','late'],group_keys=False).apply(lambda x:x.sample(len(x),replace=True,random_state=r.integers(1e9)))
        v.append(est(s))
    return np.percentile(v,[2.5,97.5])
print('est',est(w),boot(w,400))
print(w.groupby(['genre','late']).y.agg(['mean','size']).unstack())
for c in ['genre','origin','date_confidence']:
    print(pd.crosstab(w[c],w.late,normalize='columns').round(3))
print(w.groupby('late')[['n_editions','prod']].mean())
for dc in ['high','medium','low']:
    d=w[w.date_confidence==dc];print(dc,est(d),len(d))
d=w[w.date_confidence=='high'];print('high CI',boot(d,300))
m=smf.wls('y~late+C(genre)+C(origin)+C(date_confidence)+np.log(n_editions)+prod',data=w).fit(cov_type='cluster',cov_kwds={'groups':pd.factorize(w.author_key)[0]})
print(m.params['late'],m.conf_int().loc['late'].values)
print(w.groupby('decade').y.mean().round(3))
